title: SMOKED SALMON
ingredients: 1/2 pound smoked salmon, cut into narrow strips. 2 table-spoonfuls butter.  Juice of half a lemon.  Cayenne pepper.  Parboil the salmon ten minutes; lay in cold water for the same length of time; wipe dry, and broil over a clear fire. Butter while hot, season with cayenne and lemon-juice, pile in a "log-cabin" square upon a hot plate, and send up with dry toast.
